headline: Mooring County Erupts as Callums Cape Storm Endures
war_summary: Three hours on, the storm's weight has shifted. Mooring County now vies with Callums Cape as the war's busiest ground: six flag changes in the past two hours, the latest recorded three-quarters of an hour before this filing, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest works, and two-hour losses near 1,400 a side and still climbing. Callums Cape answers in kind — seven further flag moves in the same span, the last about an hour before filing, its seven posts split four to three, with Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire again the centres of the struggle. The fronts that filled earlier editions have gone quiet: the Nevish Line has seen no flag change since early morning despite a daily toll above 14,000; Godcrofts' flare at Isawa has subsided; Linn Mercy's flags rest, though its casualty lists still grow, as do those of the Weathered Expanse, and Marban Hollow is still. Callahans Passage, flag-silent since the previous evening, shows losses accelerating sharply. It is the 787th day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
